structure: Single high-school course document (Economics). Pages 2-4: context/purpose, C3 and historical thinking skills, acknowledgments (backup). Page 5 onward: one table; row 1 = Learning Outcome for the course; domain heading rows (Domain 1: Scarcity and Economic Reasoning ... Domain 8: Trade); each standard is a row with C1 = code (E.d.n, later GE.d.n) and C2 = standard text; '(E)' marks essential standards. No examples or teacher notes.
